notes.title: New update
notes.notes:
Good morning,

We've fixed a few important bugs in the previous version.

- Dragon Hunger death, now more accessible (you need to play as Jon).

- Sad Revenge death, the flow of the Arya "game of faces" was broken in the middle, it's now working again.

- The Wall mini-game and the character itself were broken. It's now fixed and should flow without interruption (and without the wall staying on the screen out of context).

- You can now do Mad Queen objective even if you decided to keep Jaime's loyalty on a different timeline.

You may have to reset the game to take advantage of these (press "R" for 5 seconds).

Thanks for your patience and your support, particularly the players who take the time to give me feedbacks.


best regards

the dev.

notes.title: Update to version 1.15
notes.notes:
Here is the list of things that should be fixed in this build:
- "More wine" that death should be easier to get.
- "Sticky wall" the wall will definitely disappear after the related battle.
- "Oh my UI" windows in the stats screen will close properly and every portrait and death should be accounted for.

Best regards,

the dev

PS: if for some reason your game behave unexpectedly after the update, press "R" for 5 seconds to reset the data and start fresh.

notes.title: 200 new cards! The West update + The Wall update.
notes.notes:
We're pushing a free update of the game that includes 200 new cards and solves a few issues you may have encountered with inaccessible royal deeds.

Note that your previous progress may be incompatible with this update. If that happens, press "R" for 5 seconds to reset the game.
